name: Muller Textiles Inc
old_description: The world's leading specialist manufacturer of spacer fabrics
about:
Muller Textiles Inc operates from Troy, Michigan, as the U.S. arm of a global family business founded in 1906. The company traces its roots to Germany, where it began as a textile enterprise and has remained under family ownership for more than a century. Today it functions as a globally active group with production facilities and branches across eleven countries.

The company specializes in three-dimensional spacer fabrics, 3D textiles, laminating materials, and spacers, marketed under the 3mesh® brand. Its products are engineered for properties such as optimum air circulation, even pressure distribution, and tactile appeal. With roughly 950 employees worldwide and eleven locations — including plants in Germany, Slovakia, the United States, Mexico, China, Japan, South Korea, Turkey, and India — the group serves both prototype and volume production needs.

Muller Textiles supplies the automotive industry, where spacer fabrics meet stringent requirements for seating, interior components, and acoustic management. Beyond automotive, the company provides customized technical textile solutions for a broad range of industrial sectors, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

The business positions itself as the world market leader in three-dimensional spacer fabrics, emphasizing its innovation leadership and a culture of developing tailored, problem-solving solutions for each client. Its certifications — including IATF 16949 at multiple sites and ISO 14001 in Slovakia and Mexico — underscore a commitment to quality and environmental management.

name: Murray Sheet Metal Co Inc.
old_description: Carbon Steel, Stainless, Galvanized, Aluminum, Specialty Metals
about:
Murray Sheet Metal Co. Inc. has operated from Parkersburg, West Virginia since 1961. The company's founding year is marked on its signage and website, though the original founders are not named in public materials.

The business runs three primary divisions: HVAC, commercial and industrial roofing, and metal fabrication. Its fabrication shop handles carbon steel, stainless steel, galvanized steel, aluminum, and specialty metals, producing structural steel, hoppers, bins, piping, furnace components, and ductwork. A waterjet cutter supports custom cutting, and the company offers welding, design/build project delivery, preventive maintenance programs, and 24/7 emergency repair service. Field crews install EPDM membrane, built-up asphalt, metal standing seam, shingles, metal wall panels, and architectural metal roofing systems.

Customers span commercial construction, industrial manufacturing, chemical processing, financial services, education, and food service. Named project partners include DuPont, United Bank, Bridgeport Equipment, and dozens of plants and schools across West Virginia and Ohio. The company also supplies restaurant and kitchen equipment.

Murray Sheet Metal emphasizes safety as a differentiator, citing an Experience Modification Rate of 0.51, a drug-free and background-checked workforce, and mandatory OSHA training (10 hours for all employees, 30 hours for superintendents). Its stated mission is to deliver exceptional customer service, tailored solutions, fair and consistent pricing, and quality workmanship performed safely.

name: Mynt Solar
old_description: Average homeowners receive $9235 back through tax incentives.
about:
Mynt Solar was founded in 2016 in Lehi, Utah, as a locally owned and operated solar and roofing contractor. The company began with a vision to provide a trustworthy service company tailored to Utah residents, accounting for local weather, economy, and home values.

Mynt Solar provides full-service solar panel installation, roofing, energy storage system installation, and energy monitoring for residential customers. The company handles marketing, sales, installation, and maintenance in-house, without subcontracting or selling contracts to third parties. It operates across Utah, Nevada, and California, offering a one-year money-back energy production guarantee on every system.

The company serves homeowners in Utah, Nevada, and California who want to reduce or eliminate electricity bills, add battery backup for grid resilience, and improve home energy efficiency. Typical customers are residential property owners seeking turnkey solar and roofing solutions with transparent pricing and no upfront costs.

Mynt Solar differentiates itself by avoiding door-to-door sales tactics, employing no commission-based salespeople, and offering $0-down financing. The firm emphasizes transparent, fixed pricing and a production guarantee that pays customers cash if systems underperform, aiming to build long-term neighborly relationships rather than one-time transactions.

old_description: For more than 30 years, NAC has helped OEMs, contract manufacturers,
about:
NAC Semi operates from Clearwater, Florida, as a business unit of NAC Group, Inc. The company has served OEMs, contract manufacturers, and government programs for more than 30 years, building a global supply chain network for electronic components and IT products.

The firm combines distribution with manufacturing services. It stocks over 1.2 million SKUs from more than 100 authorized manufacturers and offers PCB assembly, cable and wire harness fabrication, metal fabrication, and custom hardware builds. Its supply chain portfolio includes independent sourcing, counterfeit mitigation, inventory management (VMI, kitting, long-term buy stocking, consignment), and demand forecasting. On the IT side, it resells enterprise hardware, networking, data center, IoT, and software solutions through 6,000+ partner relationships.

Customers span military and aerospace, automotive, industrial, alternative energy, energy utilities, and optoelectronics sectors. The company highlights aerospace-qualified components, FPGAs for industrial and aerospace, SiC modules for EV power, and LED/display solutions. Government programs and contract manufacturers are cited as core client types.

NAC Semi emphasizes its engineering depth paired with global reach to keep critical programs on schedule. It promotes verified authenticity on every component, a counterfeit mitigation plan compliant with AS6081, AS6171, and AS5553, and a 99.9% accuracy rate in supply chain execution. A 24/7 online store provides real-time availability and pricing.

name: NB Electrical Enclosure Manufacturer Inc.
old_description: Get the Perfect Custom Enclosure at Our State-of-the Art Facility
about:
NB Electrical Enclosure Manufacturer Inc. operates from Brooklyn, New York, and was founded in 2006 by Neville Bearam. Bearam, who previously served as a project manager at Harbor Electric Fabrication & Tool (HEFTI), launched the company after accumulating over 25 years in sheet metal fabrication, including expertise in welding, shearing, bending, and CNC programming. The business is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and holds accreditation and affiliation with the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW).

The company manufactures custom electrical enclosures and provides precision sheet metal forming, fabrication, and powder coating services entirely in-house. Its facility houses a CNC Trumatic 2000R punch press, a 150-ton hydraulic press brake, and Strippit equipment, supporting processes from prototyping to full production runs. NB also offers CAD design, engineering, and field surveying services, using digital modeling to create production drawings and ensure material traceability.

NB serves clients across multiple sectors requiring custom enclosures and sheet metal solutions, with a focus on electrical and industrial applications. Its IBEW affiliation underscores ties to the electrical construction trade, while its field surveying capability supports on-site assessments for commercial and infrastructure projects.

Bearam founded NB on the premise that new technology could deliver top-quality custom enclosures at affordable prices. The company emphasizes expedited field surveys that can reduce field time by up to 80%, along with a commitment to integrity, reliability, and on-time delivery.

name: NC Solar Electric LLC
old_description: We don't believe in pushing one-size-fits-all solar kits that may not match your home, energy use, or local requirements. NC Solar Electric specializes in custom-designed solar kits and expert guidance so you can build with more confidence and get a system that actually fits your projec
about:
NC Solar Electric LLC operates from Statesville, North Carolina, where founder Todd Desiato established the company after decades of solving technical problems for energy customers. Desiato created the business to make high-quality solar more accessible to homeowners, farmers, and small businesses seeking affordable equipment, honest advice, and real engineering support.

The firm specializes in custom-designed solar kits and project rescue services for DIY installations. Its offerings include a $197 diagnostic call to review goals and identify next steps, a $479 permit and interconnection review to catch paperwork issues before submission, and a $979 full design package that delivers a bill of materials, engineering support, and permit guidance for grid-tied, battery-backup, or expansion-ready systems. All packages are built around the specific property, energy use, and utility requirements rather than pre-set configurations.

Customers range from individual homeowners tackling their first grid-tie project to farmers and small-business owners adding solar to agricultural or commercial properties. The company's project-rescue work often helps DIYers whose installations have stalled due to permitting confusion, utility interconnection hurdles, or component mismatches. Testimonials cite successful completion of grid-tied and battery-backup systems that would not have moved forward without the firm's guidance.

Desiato states the company was started to replace one-size-fits-all solar kits with tailored solutions that match each site's conditions and the owner's goals, providing direct access to engineering expertise without the markup of traditional installers.

name: NC Solar Now
old_description: We’ve been around since 2009 and we’ll be here down the road when you need us.
about:
NC Solar Now is based in Raleigh, North Carolina, and has been operating since 2009. The company was founded over a decade ago with a focus on residential solar installation and battery backup systems, though the founders are not named in public materials and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The firm provides solar panel installation, battery backup installation (including Tesla Powerwall), solar service and repair, and general electrical services. It handles the full project lifecycle — design, permitting, utility coordination, installation, and ongoing support — but does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Its primary customers are homeowners across North Carolina looking to reduce electricity costs through solar and storage. The company works closely with Duke Energy’s incentive programs, such as the Solar + Storage PowerPair™ offering, and coordinates directly with the utility for meter replacement and permission-to-operate steps. Reviews cite residential projects that include both rooftop panels and Tesla battery storage.

NC Solar Now emphasizes its local experience and long-term presence as differentiators, stating it will "be here down the road when you need us." It highlights transparency, proactive project management, and a single point of contact throughout the process as reasons customers choose them.

name: NEXT Medical Products Company
old_description: Manufacturer of sterile and non-sterile ultrasound scanning gels. Distributor of PROACT Laryngoscopes and SONO Disinfectant Wipes. Manufacturer of the OR Comfort line of patient positioning devices.
about:
NEXT Medical Products Company operates from Somerville, New Jersey. The business is a nationally certified Women’s Business Enterprise and a certified minority-owned small business.

The company manufactures sterile and non-sterile ultrasound scanning gels under the Clear Image® brand, which it acquired from Magnaflux in 2012. It also produces the OR Comfort line of adjustable patient positioning devices (acquired in 2016), an isopropyl alcohol-based hand sanitizer (since 2021), and, through its wholly owned subsidiary BLOXR Solutions (formed in 2014), patented scatter radiation protection products. In addition, NEXT Medical distributes PROACT reusable and disposable laryngoscopes (exclusive distributor for the Americas since 2017) and SONO Disinfectant Wipes (since 2015). The firm welcomes OEM and custom product inquiries.

Its products serve clinicians in surgical suites, diagnostic imaging, therapeutic procedures, and veterinary settings. Customers include hospitals, surgery centers, and medical distributors across North and South America. Specific devices such as the Shoulder-Float and Delgado positioning devices are used in lateral decubitus surgeries, while LithoClear gel supports extracorporeal shock wave lithotripsy.

The company states its mission is to help clinicians reduce costs, improve clinical outcomes, and increase patient satisfaction. It emphasizes quality and customer service as top priorities, operating under ISO 13485:2016, FDA Quality System Regulations, and Canadian Medical Device Regulations, with UDI-compliant products.

about:
NH Woodworks was founded in 2010 in Milford, New Hampshire, as a custom woodworking shop serving the New England region. The company operates from its Milford workshop, where a team of skilled craftsmen produces handcrafted wood products for residential and commercial clients.

The shop produces handcrafted custom cabinetry for kitchens and bathrooms, fireplace mantles, bar tops, entertainment centers, organizational shelving, closet systems, and entryway storage. An in-house design team works directly with clients from concept through fabrication, using traditional carpentry methods combined with modern design tools to deliver tailored solutions.

NH Woodworks serves both residential and commercial property owners across New England. Projects range from kitchen and bathroom remodels in private homes to built-in storage for vacation properties and custom bar areas for hospitality venues. The company also provides design services for commercial spaces requiring specialized millwork.

The company emphasizes a collaborative process that starts with a conversation and keeps the client involved at every stage. Its work has been featured in New England Architect Magazine and Woodshop News, reflecting a reputation for quality craftsmanship and service. name: NK Woodworking & Design
old_description: Founded in 2011, NK Woodworking & Design is one of the most respected architectural millwork & design firms in the world.
about:
NK Woodworking & Design was founded in 2011 in Seattle, Washington, by a group of skilled craftsmen, engineers, and designers who shared a passion for art and woodworking. The company began as a collaborative workshop focused on creating architectural millwork and custom art pieces for residential projects.

Today the firm operates a 12,000-square-foot woodshop in Seattle and maintains a satellite location in Los Angeles, supported by a network of artisan spaces. Its integrated process covers design, engineering, fabrication, and installation, producing custom wood, metal, and glass millwork such as curved staircases, doors, sculptural features, and built-in shelving. The fabrication team handles all production in-house and travels to project sites nationwide to lead installation.

NK Woodworking serves homeowners, interior designers, architects, and custom home builders across the United States. Its work appears in high-end residential interiors where architectural millwork is a focal point, and the company collaborates closely with design professionals from concept through final installation.

The company states that art and woodworking are its driving passion, and it emphasizes a commitment to the highest quality standards by fabricating pieces in as large sections as possible to ensure precision during on-site assembly.
